name: How are support posts, ductwork, and low ceilings handled in a custom layout?

mainEntity.name: How are support posts, ductwork, and low ceilings handled in a custom layout?

acceptedAnswer.text: Structural posts and low-hanging ductwork are integrated directly into the custom layout through intentional architectural framing, bulkheads, and furniture zoning. Rather than leaving support posts exposed awkwardly in the middle of a room, a designer can incorporate them into partition walls, built-in shelving, bar counters, or decorative architectural columns. Mechanical ducts and plumbing drop-downs are typically wrapped with clean drywall bulkheads or worked into closet spaces and laundry areas, keeping main living areas feeling open with the highest possible ceiling clearance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Support posts and ductwork are incorporated into walls, built-in cabinetry, decorative columns, or closets to preserve ceiling height and create an intentional, cohesive layout.
